purpose: One-shot read-only current billing-period usage/cost diagnostic via the self-serve Billing Read endpoint; not a zero-cost or runtime-activation authority.

execution.history_check: Require exactly this first-attempt dispatch as the only run of this V0.3 workflow on main.
execution.query_window: Current billing period; omit from/to so the provider applies its billing-cycle boundary.

query.api_generation: V1 self-serve billable usage route; do not use the V2 restricted /billable/usage path.

allowed_operations: One GitHub Actions workflow-history metadata request.
One bounded read-only Cloudflare billable-usage request.
Secret-free summary and short-retention report artifact.
forbidden_operations: Any rerun, retry, pagination, redirect following, fallback endpoint, or second Cloudflare request.
Any R2 object, D1 database, provider market-data, training, holdout, or account inventory access.
Any inference that missing rows, missing cost fields, or a zero usage subtotal means zero total project cost.
Any provisioning, migration, Cloud Paper execution, schedule activation, source switch, model promotion, or trading.
